user.title: Create a logical entity
user.description: A logical entity is a stable indirection bound to a physical entity. Pick what kind of logical entity to create.

source.title: Name and bind
source.description: Choose a name and the implementation entity this logical entity should currently proxy. You can replace it with different hardware later without losing the logical entity's identity.

error.name_blank: Name cannot be empty or contain only whitespace.
error.source_not_found: That entity could not be found in the entity registry.
error.domain_mismatch: That entity is not in the logical entity's domain.
error.logical_entity_source_rejected: A logical entity cannot be bound to another logical entity (direct bindings between logical entities are rejected).

replace_hardware.title: Replace hardware
replace_hardware.description: Currently bound to {current_source}. Choose the replacement implementation entity.

confirm_downgrade.title: Confirm capability downgrade
confirm_downgrade.description: The new hardware cannot deliver: {lost_capabilities}. These capabilities will be removed from the logical entity's contract.

logical_entity_unbound.title: {logical_entity_name} needs replacement hardware
logical_entity_unbound.description: The entity previously bound to {entity_id} was removed from the registry. The logical entity has been preserved and is unavailable. Open its Configure button to bind replacement hardware.
